repoUrl.description:
This url should be include path to repo. DO NOT include token/password in url.
Use {@link RestConfig} for Git to set auth token.
e.g. github://github.com/c3-e/c3base
@see GitUrl

pathToPkgs.description:
path in repo, where pkgs are defined. Will be read/written to this path. If not set, it will be root of repo.
e.g /base/pkgs, if your repo has /base/pkgs/foundation/foundation.c3pkg.json.

title:

@see Pkg.Store#configureWithGit
name: Pkg.Store.Git.Branch
